scope.description: All frozen authored input YAML, including draft/review states; 21 current templates have identical SHA256 to their frozen copies. Authored does not imply complete or correct.

method.action: All scalar action leaves underneath role.pipe; no event references in waits_for counted as actions. YAML AST identities distinguish alias declaration from expanded occurrences.
method.definition: An info.verb key binding, its normalized meaning scalar declaration, and alias-expanded bindings are counted separately. Existing units.jsonl independently verifies all 1173 operator/text groups and 5349 source text declarations.
method.semantic_group_warning: A normalized text group is not a semantic equivalence class.
method.review: All 141 lexical types enumerated; representative variant definitions and existing complete field-audit annotations/action-review inspected. No claim to re-audit all 1173 texts from scratch.
method.group_trace: definition_groups sources columns are [node,line,end_line]; file is inputs/<operator>/<node>.yaml. Exact normalized text and full field paths are in archive/data/<operator>/units.jsonl, keyed by id; classifications are in annotations/<operator>.json. SHA256 verifies normalized text. File indices refer to files in this census.
